turns.text: hi! can u make me a thank-you card image, flyer style? its for a coworker covering my shift tmrw. simple, nothing crazy ☕
Happy to! A couple of quick things so it fits: what's her name, and do you want it playful or more sincere? Any colors you like?
name is sam. playful pls. coffee themed, cream and brown + a little green. i have to be at lotus nails front desk after my cafe shift today so keep it quick lol

[Image: A flyer-style card on a cream background with a brown border. A big latte-cup illustration with a heart in the foam sits at the top, with small green leaf accents in the corners. Headline in brown script: "THANK YOU, SAM!" Below it: "For covering my shift, you're a legend." Small footer line: "Next coffee's on me. - [your name]"]

Want the footer tweaked, or a different line under the headline?
perfect, leave it. ok second thing, a meal reminder i can use as my phone wallpaper
Sure! What should it say, and how do you want it to feel? Cheerful, calm, bold?
should say something like eat lunch. but NOT bossy. my sister texted me this morning about eating and i was like.. ok i KNOW. so nothing that sounds like her nagging
Got it, so we'll make it feel like a gentle nudge you'd give yourself, not an order. Any color preferences?
warm muted colors, like the old vietnamese ballads my dad used to play on his radio. kinda faded amber and dusty rose

[Image: A phone wallpaper in a soft gradient of faded amber to dusty rose, with a subtle grain like an old paper sleeve. A small vintage radio line drawing sits near the bottom. Centered in thin cream lettering: "lunch is waiting for you." Below, in smaller text: "rice bowl o'clock 🍚" The top third is left clear so your clock and icons stay readable.]

I kept the wording friendly rather than commanding. Want a different line, like "snack break, you've earned it"?
no this is good. kenji said someone landed an internship already lol. whatever. thanks!! ok im gonna eat now
Glad you like it! Enjoy the meal, and good luck with the shift today. 🍚
